name: Barrachina (Spain)
description: A white hoist stripe with red and yellow bars above and below bearing a green tree, separated by a green line from the red fly charged with a yellow bend.
history: Municipal flag of Barrachina; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: bars of red and yellow at the top and bottom of the hoist stripe and bend on the red fly
bend from the upper hoist of the fly to the lower fly
